parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the values for specific response parameters. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of addresses. Valid values:

*   IPV4: IPv4 address
*   IPv6: IPv6 address
*   DOMAIN: domain name

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-dns-gtm-addr-attribute-info --lang en --type IPV4 --addrs 1.1.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeDnsGtmAddrAttributeInfo --region cn-hangzhou --Addrs '1.1.XX.XX' --Type IPV4 --Lang en
